multi-screens.name: Multi Screens 1.10.2
multi-screens.body:
The Print Screen key is left to Smart Snap.

### Downloads

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **Print Screen no longer starts Note anywhere.** Windows 11 gives the key to its Snipping Tool before any app sees it, and Smart Snap 1.2 now takes it for an area snap in every program, Multi Screens included. **Alt+N** still starts Note anywhere.
- **The handbook**, `Multi-Screens-Handbook-1.10.2.pdf`, with the Keys page to match. Replaced the same day: its pictures retaken, mixed between the dark and light appearance, and the SCAFFApps Suite on the back page as it is in 1.0.3.

### Updating from 1.10.1

- Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.

### Tested

- This installer over 1.10.1 on a working computer, silently with Windows' permission: installed in 4 seconds, Windows lists 1.10.2. The installed app has no Print Screen shortcut left in it.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.

smart-snap.name: Smart Snap 1.2.4
smart-snap.body:
## 1.2.4 — 17 November 2026

Every snapped program shows its own icon, the SCAFFApps apps' included.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Smart-Snap-Setup-1.2.4.exe` | 71.1 MB | `AA90E57D04595B32735DF82E70D2D06C758D3631F6B459EEF43D341E0FD7238E` |
| `Smart-Snap-Handbook-1.2.4.pdf` | 3.7 MB | `25B04E8FD869F02367159FD1277AB965F9B1BE5D3BE087EEB8C4B040FAEA05C9` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Fixed

- **A snap of a program whose icon is stored as PNG pictures now shows that program's icon**, not Windows' plain program icon. This includes the SCAFFApps Suite, Smart Snap, Instant Share, Multi Screens and many other programs, and it applies in the list, in the snap's details, in the PDF report and in Copy as picture. Windows now draws the icon, as Explorer and the taskbar do, at 64 pixels so it stays sharp in print. The icon reader built into Smart Snap's engine (Chromium) cannot read PNG icons and handed back the plain one; it is now used only when Windows cannot answer. Snaps taken before this version keep the icon they were saved with.

### Changed

- **The handbook**, `Smart-Snap-Handbook-1.2.4.pdf`: 1.2.3's pages and pictures, unchanged.

### Updating from 1.2.3 or earlier

- Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.

### Tested

- Smart Snap's window helper asked for the icons of the SCAFFApps Suite, Smart Snap, Instant Share, Multi Screens, Microsoft Edge and Notepad: each came back as the program's own icon, 64 × 64 with transparent corners. A program without an icon (curl.exe) and a missing file answer with nothing.
- Smart Snap's own code for this (starting the helper, asking it, the fallback), run in a signed-in Windows session: the SCAFFApps Suite, Smart Snap and Edge got their own icons. The first answer took about 0.3 s while the helper started, later ones about 2 ms. Programs without an icon still got Windows' plain icon from the fallback.
- The cause, proven: the same SCAFFApps Suite program file was stamped once with bitmap icon pictures and once with PNG ones. Chromium's reader gave the real icon for the first and the plain one for the second.
- Installed over 1.2.3 on a working computer the way the SCAFFApps Suite updates it (silently, with Windows' permission): Windows lists 1.2.4, Smart Snap opened again, and its window helper runs with the new icon command.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.

### Not tested

- **A real snap of a SCAFFApps app after updating** was not driven by a test (tests never snap the screen of the computer they run on); it saves through the same code tested above.

instant-share.name: Instant Share 1.3.6
instant-share.body:
## 1.3.6 — 16 November 2026

The tray icon's menu in the SCAFFApps style, the same as Smart Snap's and the SCAFFApps Suite's.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Instant-Share-Setup-1.3.6.exe` | 13.8 MB | `80C82D240274DE81253970FB8C5C45AAC93AA8465B3DFC1C521475E22C0A8CB8` |
| `Instant-Share-1.3.6.apk` | 70 KB | `F721D016F621CD48350DCE9231927283232D90AD802F2A3730A9917D7B59EE0F` |
| `instantshare.py` | 169 KB | `1B92FF7C493D3DF5868015D41DCE06BD1024C237D9A8002567CA61C5FDE4B3C9` |
| `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` | 143 KB | `DF09683971A8AC3754A73BA27E0A40FB2F14535DB0C554ADA30A2C62E85E6A07` |
| `Instant-Share-Handbook-1.3.6.pdf` | 3.2 MB | `18C957EA76AC7904D24ED0B4501B5245784EDCE598996AFF4B61F144832129BE` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, and Android 10 and newer. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **The tray icon's menu** is now the menu every SCAFFApps app has: taller rows, the whole row lit under the pointer, rounded corners, dark or light as Windows is. The same items as before: Open Instant Share, Add a device…, Start with Windows, Change setup… and Quit Instant Share. Instant Share draws it itself, still without any third-party code.
- **No empty gap on the left**: the menu makes room for the tick only while **Start with Windows** is ticked.
- **The handbook**, `Instant-Share-Handbook-1.3.6.pdf`: 1.3.4's pages and pictures, with the new version.

(1.3.5 was made but not published: 1.3.6 is the same with the gap gone.)

### Updating

- **Windows, from 1.3.0 to 1.3.4:** Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.
- **Android:** nothing changed in the app but its version number; **Update now** in the app installs it, or keep 1.3.4.

### Tested

- From the source code in a test profile: the tray icon right-clicked the way Windows tells it, the menu drawn without the tick's room, **Start with Windows** ticked through it (into a test entry, not the real list) and the menu then drawn with it, Esc closes it, **Quit Instant Share** ends the program.
- The menu next to Smart Snap's, both at 150 %, with an item ticked: the same size to the pixel (259 × 273 against Electron's 258 × 273), the same rows, colours, tick, text and hover, in the dark and the light appearance. Windows 11 gives it a slightly larger shadow.
- Installed over 1.3.5 on a working computer the way the updates do it (silently, with Windows' permission): Windows lists 1.3.6, Instant Share opened again, and its tray menu opens without the gap and closes with Esc.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer or the Android app.
